notes: Governmental funds on the modified cash basis (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column p6); business-type on the accrual basis (proprietary statement p8, net position), as in FY2023. basis set to cash (modified cash); the governmental roll-forward uses fund balances: 462,338 + 389,336 - 608,093 - transfers out 8,010 = 235,571. No beginning cash is printed (no prior-year column); ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet Cash and cash equivalents (457,052) negative (p4); investments 624,288 separate; certificates of deposit 64,208 and county treasurer cash 4,127 also on p4 (not in the cash fields). Transfers: Total column net (8,010) out. Governmental net position not recorded (modified cash basis). Business-type: 2,308,880 + 2,537,090 - 1,054,979 + transfers 8,010 = 3,799,001; loss on investments (29,873) and loss on disposal of assets (1,563) kept as negative receipts (the Statement of Activities shows both among general revenues; total business-type expenses 1,054,979). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (its total 235,571 equals the government-wide governmental net position), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position business-type column; component unit (Beaver City Manor) excluded. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp17-18), not the General Fund budgetary comparison (p11), to avoid double counting; other governmental funds from their budgetary comparison schedules (pp12-16); budget lines with no actual are not recorded. No utility fund schedules, so no business-type detail. Proprietary cash flow statement prints no investing section (investing null). Read pages 1-18 of 18
